inputRootSignature: theorem asymptotic_normality_of_sample_variance {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (mean varianceSq fourthMoment : ℝ) (G : Ω → ℝ) (hX_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hX_indep : iIndepFun X P) (hX_ident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) (hfourth_integrable : Integrable (fun ω ↦ |X 0 ω| ^ 4) P) (hmean : ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂P = mean) (hvariance : ∫ ω, (X 0 ω - mean) ^ 2 ∂P = varianceSq) (hfourth : ∫ ω, (X 0 ω - mean) ^ 4 ∂P = fourthMoment) (hgap : varianceSq ^ 2 < fourthMoment) (hG_meas : Measurable G) (hG_law : IdentDistrib G id P (gaussianReal 0 ⟨fourthMoment - varianceSq ^ 2, sub_nonneg.mpr hgap.le⟩)) : let Xbar : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω let V : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - Xbar n ω) ^ 2 TendstoInDistribution (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * (V n ω - varianceSq)) atTop G P
